title: McGregor summer research, presented
body: Ian Hawthorne and Nathan Holtrop presented Teaching Ancient Wisdom with Modern AI, their McGregor Undergraduate Research Fellowship project on how reliably large language models handle early Christian sources.

photos.alt: Nathan Holtrop, Eric Araújo and Ian Hawthorne standing in front of a projection screen in a Calvin seminar room after the presentation, a grand piano and music stands off to the side.
photos.caption: Nathan Holtrop, me and Ian Hawthorne after their presentation, 17 July.

title: Baylor Symposium on Faith & Culture
body: Technology and the Human Person in the Age of AI, in Waco. Dinner with Rosalind Picard and Derek Schuurman the evening before my own paper on modeling Christian communities.

photos.alt: Rosalind Picard, Derek Schuurman and Eric Araújo standing together in a Baylor banquet hall, conference lanyards on, round tables set for dinner behind them.
photos.caption: With Rosalind Picard and Derek Schuurman, 26 February.

title: Ronald Feenstra's last lecture
body: Professor Ronald Feenstra's final lecture at Calvin Theological Seminary.

photos.alt: Ronald Feenstra and Eric Araújo standing together in a Calvin Theological Seminary classroom, the projection screen still lit behind them.
photos.caption: With Ronald Feenstra afterwards, 29 April.

title: Commencement
body: Katelin Jandris across the stage, and the last commencement for two colleagues — Keith Vander Linden and Cynthia Betcher, both retiring after long careers at Calvin.

photos.alt: Katelin Jandris in cap and gown with an honours medal, standing between her fiancé and Eric Araújo in doctoral regalia outside on a bright spring day.
photos.caption: Katelin Jandris and her fiancé, 8 May.

photos.alt: Keith Vander Linden and Eric Araújo in full academic regalia in the fieldhouse before the commencement procession.
photos.caption: With Keith Vander Linden, retiring.

photos.alt: Cynthia Betcher in red doctoral regalia beside Eric Araújo, faculty gathering behind them on the fieldhouse track.
photos.caption: With Cynthia Betcher, also retiring.

title: My parents in Grand Rapids
body: My mum and dad came over in early June — a week that took in my office at Calvin and an afternoon out at the gardens.

photos.alt: Eric Araújo with his parents and another family member in his Calvin office, bookshelves behind them and complexity notation still on the chalkboard.
photos.caption: In my office at Calvin, 4 June.

photos.alt: The four of them by a fountain and bronze sculpture at Frederik Meijer Gardens on a bright summer day.
photos.caption: Meijer Gardens, 10 June.

title: NetLogo Conference, Chicago
body: Ryan Klein presented Cognitive Modeling of Church Polarization at UIC — the senior project he built with Katelin Jandris and Övgü Tufan. Ryan and Miriam Crisman made the trip; we found the Bean on the way in, two days before the talk.

photos.alt: Ryan Klein at a UIC lectern beside a projected title slide listing the project's authors — Eric Araújo, Ryan Klein, Katelin Jandris and Övgü Tufan — under the NetLogo Conference 2026 logo.
photos.caption: Ryan Klein presenting at UIC, 1 July.

photos.alt: Miriam Crisman, Ryan Klein and Eric Araújo in Millennium Park, Cloud Gate and the Chicago skyline behind them on a bright afternoon.
photos.caption: With Miriam Crisman and Ryan Klein in Millennium Park, 29 June.

title: Around the table for Prompted
body: Six half-hour episodes putting administrators, faculty, staff and students at the same table — conversational sense-making, as host Craig Mattson calls it. Season 2 asks whether AI is a research assistant, an idol, a demonic force, or the "thou" of Buber's dialogic ethics. My episode previews the Wisdom in the Age of AI conference and the summer research into what large language models actually know about two fourth-century Christian women.

photos.alt: Eric Araújo seated at a podcast recording table with a student and host Craig Mattson, boom microphones and headphones between them in a sound-treated studio.
photos.caption: Recording Prompted with a Calvin student and host Craig Mattson.

title: Faith & Learning Fellowship
body: A semester with the de Vries Institute for Global Faculty Development, reading and arguing about what it means to do scholarship as a Christian — with colleagues from across the university. Last meeting of the cohort, snow outside.

photos.alt: Seven faculty around a seminar table in a bright Calvin meeting room, laptops and books open, snow on the ground through the windows behind them.
photos.caption: Front: Cynthia Slagter, Liesl Zilstra, John Scritchfield, me. Back: Sabrina Lee, Matt Lundberg and Ken Visser. 11 December.

title: First day at the seminary
body: Amy and I started taking classes at Calvin Theological Seminary this fall. One course at a time, as the teaching load allows.

photos.alt: A group of new seminary students with name tags standing at the front of the Calvin Theological Seminary chapel, tall mosaic-flanked windows and wood panelling behind them.
photos.caption: The incoming group in the seminary chapel, Fall 2025.

title: Commencement
body: The first commencement of my Calvin years, with the computer science faculty lined up outside before the procession.

photos.alt: Five computer science faculty in academic regalia outside a brick campus building on a spring morning.
photos.caption: Derek Schuurman, me, Keith Vander Linden, Victor Norman and Ken Arnold, May 2025.

title: Jennifer Powell McNutt on the Mary we forgot
body: An amazing talk. Jennifer Powell McNutt, author of The Mary We Forgot: What the Apostle to the Apostles Teaches the Church Today, at Calvin University and the seminary for the Healthy Dialogue series.

photos.alt: Jennifer Powell McNutt speaking at a wooden lectern, laptop open, beside a projected slide with two paintings of Mary Magdalene.
photos.caption: Jennifer Powell McNutt at the lectern, 18 February.

title: ASA Annual Meeting, Colorado
body: The American Scientific Affiliation's annual meeting at Colorado Christian University in Lakewood, where I presented the computational modeling work on political polarization in Christian communities. An afternoon in downtown Denver with Prof. Fernando Santos the day before the talk.

photos.alt: Fernando Santos and Eric Araújo on the 16th Street Mall in downtown Denver, glass office towers and a summer-concert poster behind them.
photos.caption: With Fernando Santos, 16th Street, Denver, 18 July.

title: Grace Hopper Celebration, Chicago
body: The world's largest gathering of women in computing, and Calvin's Girls Who Code delegation in the middle of it: Maddy Bratt, Rose Campbell, Anna St. Clair and Zuriel Olu-Silas. Closing plenary on the Friday, then a stop at the Bean on the way out of town.

photos.alt: Eric Araújo with four Calvin students in conference lanyards in the McCormick Place arena before the GHC 2025 closing plenary, the countdown clock and the Unbound stage lit in pink and violet behind them.
photos.caption: Before the closing plenary, 7 November.

photos.alt: The five of them in autumn jackets in front of Cloud Gate, the Chicago skyline curving in the mirror above them under a grey November sky.
photos.caption: Cloud Gate the next morning, 8 November.

title: Arriving at Calvin
body: First time in my new office: North Hall 293, name already on the door. Amy claimed the chalkboard before I had unpacked a single book.

photos.alt: Eric Araújo, hand on the door handle, and Amy standing at the open door of office NH 293, the nameplate reading E. Araújo, Computer Science.
photos.caption: NH 293, 22 July.

photos.alt: Amy at the office chalkboard, chalk in hand, having written "Eric's office" with a smiley face.
photos.caption: Amy's contribution to the chalkboard.

title: Defending the thesis
body: 5 September 2018, at the Vrije Universiteit Amsterdam: the defense of Contagious: Modeling the Spread of Behaviours, Perceptions and Emotions in Social Networks. White tie, the committee in gowns, the diploma in its green tube, and everyone who came, in the hall afterwards.

photos.alt: Eric Araújo in white tie receiving the green diploma tube from a professor in gown and beret on the stage, a colleague in white tie holding a copy of Contagious behind him, the VU lectern to the side.
photos.caption: The diploma, 5 September.

photos.alt: Eric Araújo at the centre of a large group of family, friends, colleagues and gowned committee members in the VU foyer after the defense.
photos.caption: Everyone who came, in the foyer afterwards.

photos.alt: Close-up of the thesis cover: Contagious in yellow letters over a grey network pattern, the subtitle set inside a white hexagon.
photos.caption: Contagious, the printed thesis.

title: PRS training in New York
body: A week with the Grace & Mercy Foundation's Young Leaders Training Conference, learning to bring the Public Reading of Scripture and the Just Show Up book club to Calvin. Cohort photo above Central Park on the first evening.

photos.alt: Eric Araújo with seven others from the Young Leaders Training cohort, arms around each other on a rooftop terrace, Central Park and the Manhattan skyline behind them under an overcast sky.
photos.caption: The Young Leaders Training cohort, New York, 7 July.

title: First winter in Grand Rapids
body: Snow on the chapel roof and on everything else. Our first Michigan winter, a long way from Minas Gerais. Lucy took to it better than we did.

photos.alt: Amy and Eric Araújo bundled in hats and scarves on a snowy campus road, the Calvin Chapel's pyramid roof and spire white with snow behind them.
photos.caption: With Amy by the Calvin Chapel, 23 December.

photos.alt: Lucy, a fawn French bulldog in a navy winter coat, standing in fresh snow with snowflakes on her muzzle, looking up at the camera.
photos.caption: Lucy, in her winter coat.

title: A new soccer stadium
body: Calvin inaugurated its new soccer stadium on an October evening. A Brazilian in the stands for the opening ceremony, with the scoreboard still at 0–0.

photos.alt: The centre circle of Calvin's new soccer field seen from the stands, a row of honourees seated beside a lectern on the pitch and the Calvin Knights video board lit red behind them.
photos.caption: Opening ceremony at the new stadium, 5 October.

title: Lunch at Rose's
body: Amy's parents, Alan and Mandy, with us on the deck at Rose's on Reeds Lake, a few weeks into life in Grand Rapids.

photos.alt: Amy, Eric Araújo, Alan and Mandy around a round table under orange umbrellas on the lakeside deck at Rose's, Reeds Lake behind them on a bright August afternoon.
photos.caption: Amy, me, Alan and Mandy at Rose's, 18 August.

title: Saying goodbye to Brazil
body: The hardest part of the move, at the end of June: saying goodbye to my dear sons, Moises and Tiago.

photos.alt: Amy, Eric Araújo and Moises smiling together at the airport kerb under a Ride App Services sign, Eric and Moises both in pink shirts.
photos.caption: Amy, me and Moises at the airport.

photos.alt: Eric Araújo in a plaid shirt with his arm around Tiago, in a green T-shirt, in a café.
photos.caption: With Tiago.

title: L'Abri retreat on AI
body: One of the last things before leaving Brazil: speaking at the L'Abri retreat on artificial intelligence. The talk, in Portuguese, was IAs, ChatGPT e seus desafios para a sociedade.

photos.alt: Eric Araújo in a flat cap speaking from a wooden table in a brick-walled hall, the title slide IAs, ChatGPT e seus desafios para a sociedade projected behind him.
photos.caption: The talk, 22 June.

photos.alt: Eric Araújo and Guilherme de Carvalho, both in flat caps, standing together outdoors at night.
photos.caption: With Guilherme de Carvalho that evening.

title: With Bruna and Ana
body: A special couple of days with my sister Bruna and my niece Ana, part of the long goodbye before leaving Brazil.

photos.alt: Ana, Bruna, Amy and Eric Araújo crowded into a selfie on a grand staircase, ornate railings and a large tapestry behind them.
photos.caption: Ana, Bruna, Amy and me in Belo Horizonte, 31 May.

photos.alt: Eric Araújo in a straw hat and Ana in pink glasses, both in white shirts, in front of a bronze sculpture among palms.
photos.caption: Ana and me at Inhotim, 1 June.

photos.alt: Ana riding piggyback on Eric Araújo, arms around his neck, both grinning under a bright blue sky.
photos.caption: Ana on board, Inhotim.

title: New Year in the Netherlands
body: The turn of the year with Amy's family and our friends the de Boers. A grey day on the IJ ferry in Amsterdam, and warm evenings indoors.

photos.alt: Daniel, Amy, David and Eric Araújo bundled up on the deck of the Amsterdam IJ ferry, the A'DAM tower and the towers of Overhoeks behind them under a grey sky.
photos.caption: Daniel (Amy's brother), me, Amy and our friend David on the IJ ferry, Amsterdam, 27 December.

photos.alt: Eric Araújo and Amy on a leather sofa between the de Boers, two of their sons at the coffee table in front, bookshelves and a stained-glass lamp around them.
photos.caption: An evening in with the de Boer family.

title: Tiradentes with José Luiz and Lívia
body: Touristing Tiradentes with our beloved friends José Luiz and Lívia: the baroque fountain, the Matriz de Santo Antônio, and the cobbled lanes between.

photos.alt: Amy, José Luiz, Lívia and Eric Araújo in a tilted selfie in front of the blue-and-white baroque Chafariz de São José, dated 1749 on its face.
photos.caption: Amy, José Luiz, Lívia and me at the Chafariz de São José.

photos.alt: José Luiz and Eric Araújo arm in arm under a tree in front of the white-and-gold façade of the Matriz de Santo Antônio, the Serra de São José behind.
photos.caption: José Luiz and me at the Matriz.

photos.alt: Amy in a wide straw hat and sunglasses with Lívia beside her on a sunlit cobbled lane between old stone walls.
photos.caption: Amy and Lívia.

title: With my grandpa José
body: The last picture I took with my grandpa José, before he passed. He was a hard-working man, with a lot of determination and stubbornness. I believe I inherited a bit of it.

photos.alt: Eric Araújo with his arm around his grandfather José on a grey sofa, both smiling at the camera.
photos.caption: Grandpa José and me, 12 May.

title: Calvin's first football game
body: Calvin University's first ever American football game, against Oberlin at Eagle Stadium, and our first American football game full stop. In the bleachers with the Santos family. Calvin won.

photos.alt: Fernando, Jemima, Suzana, Nael, Amy and Eric Araújo squeezed together on the bleachers in the sun, Calvin caps and hoodies on, a chain-link fence and the field behind them.
photos.caption: Fernando, Jemima, Suzana, Nael, Amy and me, 7 September.

title: Goodbye, Lucy
body: Lucy passed in January. She was there for our first Michigan winter and for so much before it. We are still grieving her.

photos.alt: Black-and-white portrait of Lucy, a French bulldog, her greying muzzle lit from one side against a dark background, resting on a rumpled white sheet.
photos.caption: Lucy.

title: Farewell to the Netherlands
body: Our farewell party from the Netherlands, in a back garden strung with bunting and paper lanterns.

photos.alt: Ten friends on garden chairs around a leather ottoman at dusk, bunting and paper lanterns strung overhead, Eric Araújo in the middle in a black T-shirt, Dutch terraced houses behind the fence.
photos.caption: The farewell party, 4 September.

title: The day we were overjoyed by the Lord
body: Our religious wedding ceremony at our church, Christ Church Amsterdam on the Groenburgwal, 2 September 2016. It was another life: I was a PhD student at the Vrije Universiteit, Amy worked for a headhunter company, and we were not looking for marriage. But we were listening to God and to His plans for us. We were blessed with the best photographer, Benjamin Arthur, and with the best family and friends. It was a day. Oh boy, that was a day. Some friends are not with us anymore; we miss our master of ceremonies, Jenn West, dearly. New friends appeared. Old friends are still old friends. And God is still the same, the main part of our lives.

photos.alt: Amy in a white satin dress and veil, orange-and-cream bouquet in hand, coming through the church doorway on the arm of a man in a dark suit.
photos.caption: Amy coming in.

photos.alt: Eric Araújo in a grey suit and orange tie kissing Amy in front of the carved wooden reredos of Christ Church, the Creed and the Lord's Prayer painted in gold behind them.
photos.caption: At the front of the church.

photos.alt: Eric Araújo in suit and boutonnière with family in the ivy-covered courtyard, a toddler in a white dress held in the middle of the group.
photos.caption: With family in the courtyard.

photos.alt: Seen from the gallery, the whole congregation in the pews waving up at the camera, Eric and Amy at the front by the altar rail.
photos.caption: Everyone, from the gallery.

title: Civil wedding at the Stadhuis
body: Our civil wedding at the Amsterdam city hall, 4 May 2016, with a small circle of friends, and a photo by the canal afterwards. The church ceremony came four months later.

photos.alt: Eric Araújo in a grey suit signing the register beside Amy in a short white dress, an orange-and-white bouquet on the table in front of them.
photos.caption: Signing, 4 May.

photos.alt: Eric and Amy seated on a leather bench in the city hall wedding room, a row of friends applauding behind them.
photos.caption: The room at the city hall.

photos.alt: The wedding party of fourteen lined up on a sunny canal bank under a willow, Amy with her bouquet at the centre.
photos.caption: By the canal afterwards.

title: Leaving for Amsterdam
body: Farewell at the airport in Belo Horizonte, August 2014, before taking off to Amsterdam for the PhD. Family and friends came to see me off.

photos.alt: Eric Araújo with three friends in front of the Laselva bookstore in the Belo Horizonte airport terminal.
photos.caption: Friends at the airport.

photos.alt: Eric Araújo with his arms around two women in the airport hall, a café counter behind them.
photos.caption: Family, before the flight.

photos.alt: Eric Araújo between two women in the departures hall, a Tiradentes gastronomy festival poster on a pillar behind them.
photos.caption: Family, before the flight.

photos.alt: Eric Araújo with a woman in sunglasses and a man in a grey T-shirt in the airport hall.
photos.caption: Family, before the flight.

title: CS Department Retreat
body: The computer science department retreat before the fall semester, 26 August 2025. The whole department on one deck.

photos.alt: Ten computer science faculty standing on a wooden deck under a bright late-summer sky, trees and a lake behind the railing.
photos.caption: Left to right: Joel Adams, Derek Schuurman, Chris Wieringa, Victor Norman, me, Ken Arnold, Fernando Santos, Harry Plantinga, Rocky Chang and Keith Vander Linden. 26 August.

title: She said yes
body: 19 March 2016, at The Lobby on the Nes, after Amy came back from the Christ Church women's retreat. I pretended to go to the WC and passed the ring to the waiter. I had ordered one simple dessert, because the budget was tight; the restaurant brought a plate with every dessert on the menu, and champagne on the house. The most important part: she said yes. God gave me more than I deserve. Much more. Infinitely more.

photos.alt: Eric Araújo sliding a ring onto Amy's finger across a candlelit restaurant table, a plate of assorted desserts between them.
photos.caption: The dessert plate, the ring, and the yes. The Lobby, 19 March.

title: Honeymoon in Venice
body: Honeymoon in Venice, May 2016, after the civil wedding.

photos.alt: Eric Araújo in an Ajax shirt and Amy kissing on a low brick wall beside a Venetian lagoon canal, a wooden bridge, coloured houses and a bell tower behind them under a clear sky.
photos.caption: Amy and me on the lagoon, Venice, May 2016.
